_comment: Each entry mirrors an app's index.html into apps/<id>/index.html. The sync workflow (scripts/sync-mirrors.sh, .github/workflows/sync-mirrors.yml) pulls from <repo>/<branch>/<file> on a schedule and opens a PR if anything changed. Only add apps that need same-origin embedding (FSA picker, navigator.storage.getDirectory, etc.). Cross-origin embedding via app.url is still preferred for everything else.
